name: How should I prepare my kitchen before countertop installation begins?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my kitchen before countertop installation begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before the templating crew arrives, clear all small appliances, food containers, and clutter from the existing counter surfaces. You must have your exact sink, cooktop, faucet, and any integrated soap dispensers or air switches physically on-site so technicians can record exact cutout dimensions. Clear a wide path from your home entrance through to the kitchen so technicians can carry large, heavy templates and stone slabs safely without bumping walls, door frames, or delicate interior trim.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear off all counters, have your new sink, cooktop, and plumbing fixtures on-site for accurate cutout measurements, and make sure pathways are completely clear for the installation crew.
